ننتصف (form VIII)
# نَنْتَصِفُ (nantaṣifu) /nan.ta.sˤi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَفَ (intaṣafa)
# نَنْتَصِفَ (nantaṣifa) /nan.ta.sˤi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَصَفَ (intaṣafa)
# نَنْتَصِفْ (nantaṣif) /nan.ta.sˤif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَصَفَ (intaṣafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
